author: KadirGarib
body:
Since my thread was locked, I didn't get a chance to respond to your rhetorical question.

"Do you always act like that when you don't get your way?
EDIT: If you believe that a mod should not have the position please convey your opinion/evidence to our support email thanks"

Regarding the question, in what way am I acting up? I shared my logic, I'm sorry if you cannot take criticism personally, not my problem :). I asked to be web-banned as well, since there's no point of me being here, and considering I rarely post now... At the very least, just delete my account, profile etc. 

Regarding Porky, is evidence necessary? Just look at his page of infractions, and I don't believe "a few months" is considered as 2. When I came on the forum, he was already unbanned...Not going to deny this, but he's a nice guy in general.

Next time, allow me to respond, instead of locking a thread prior to your own ignorance @Lord_Draksis. You asked a question, and without even letting me respond, you already locked the thread. Stupidity at it's finest. Anyways, go ahead and lock this thread, you asked the question, I've given my response :). (Unless you have any more of your rhetorical questions)

I'll kindly request someone to remove my forum account and profile. I have better things to do, including managing/developing Cubition.

replies.body:
I'll do Draksis the favor.

It was due to my bad judgement that you weren't banned earlier, because I actually thought you were PvPing legit! Anyways, you're not giving constructive criticism, you're just BSing because we caught you hacking red-handed.

Go on ahead and work on Cubition, we'll sure miss you a ton.

Denied.
